comparison.objective: Retrieve a block from a cyclic machine hazard zone only during the parked phase; candidate tunes an isolated damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Time entry and withdrawal around a moving bar plus pick-and-place versus precision maintenance tooling, rotary adjustment and guarded test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Immediate zero if robot or block comes within 2 cm of the bar; full score requires stable tray placement. Candidate requires de-energized adjustment followed by controlled cycles without bottoming, rebound or hard-stop contact.
comparison.reason: Both involve moving-machine safety, but temporal hazard avoidance is different from physical damper commissioning.
